context_in: Tempus Nativitatis > S. Familiae > II Vesp. > ant1 'Post triduum' (engraving runs over from p82)
context_out: Tempus Nativitatis > S. Familiae > II Vesp. > resp 'Debuit per omnia' (Ɽ br.) runs over to p84

rows.text: Descendit Iesus cum eis et venit Nazareth, et erat + subditus illis.
rows.notes: Lc 2,51; ARII 65 cites 16720. Opening g gf d, Ie(ef) sus(gh) cum(h) e(g)is, Ná(jk) matches; same group as Verona 14363.

rows.text: Puer Iesus proficiebat ætate et sapientia coram Deo et hominibus.
rows.notes: Lc 2,52; CAO 4410; ARII 66. Candidates 2178/8341/13006 (Solesmes, 'Je'/'ae') vs Verona 14431 (Iesus, æ, same spelling as the page); melodies differ only in small ornaments (ffg vs ffog on sus; a-end). Verona chosen as on p82.

rows.text: Debuit per omnia fratribus similari * Ut misericors fieret. In terris visus
rows.notes: Heb 2,17; ARII 67. Engraving begins at foot of p83, continues on p84. Index identity 8244.

flags: Post triduum (II Vesp. ant1, begun p82) ends at top of this page (los et interrogantem eos. Euouae): continues, no row.
Index #1015 'Descendit Iesus cum eis' (19/3, II Vesp. ant3, St Joseph) links to this page but p83 prints it only under S. Familiae ant2; not placed. Index-only claim.
Puer Iesus identity: Solesmes and Verona editions differ only in minor ornaments; 14431 chosen for spelling consistent with the OCO text.
Responsory Debuit per omnia: engraving continues on p84 (verse, Gloria).
